content.title: BIGBANG Launches 20th Anniversary with Coachella Showcase
content.text: [OSEN=Jang Woo-young Reporter] BIGBANG announces the start of a grand 20th-anniversary party by taking the Coachella stage.BIGBANG will perform on the Outdoor Theatre, a main stage of the world's largest music festival, Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival (hereinafter referred to as 'Coachella'), which will be held in Indio, California, USA, on April 12 and 19 (local time), showcasing an approximately 60-minute performance.Coachella, which began in 1999, is a traditional and prestigious festival that attracts 200,000 to 300,000 spectators annually. It holds authority as it invites not only popular singers but also artists with musicality, and many artists dream of performing on its stage.BIGBANG's connection with Coachella was almost realized in 2020. BIGBANG, who aimed to showcase their first complete group performance post-military service at Coachella, left regrets as the festival was canceled due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Reconnecting with Coachella after six years, BIGBANG has prepared to make the world fall for them again with a three-member complete group performance.Notably, 2026, the year BIGBANG will perform at Coachella, marks their 20th anniversary since debut, a milestone year. BIGBANG, who debuted on August 19, 2006, is the group that made not only South Korea but the world fall into K-pop fever. Their hits, including "Haru Haru," "FANTASTIC BABY," "Bang Bang Bang," "Lie," "Last Farewell," "Spring Summer Fall Winter," "BLUE," "Kkotgil," and "MONSTER," are too numerous to list.Not only as a group but also as solo artists, G-Dragon, Taeyang, and Daesung have been as active as the group itself. G-Dragon, who released his third regular album last year and demonstrated his vitality through a world tour; Daesung, who showcased a wide musical spectrum through various variety shows and new trot songs; and Taeyang, who began full-fledged activities with his new album 'on the 1st'—they have proven the group's continued relevance through diverse solo activities.On the 10th, about three days before the performance, various social media accounts unexpectedly previewed stages of "BANG BANG BANG," "FANTASTIC BABY," and "WE LIKE 2 PARTY," heightening anticipation. The setlist, which encompasses numerous hit songs, is expected to satisfy the waiting fans worldwide.While Coachella is a significant event in itself, this performance is even more anticipated as it marks the beginning of BIGBANG's grand 20th-anniversary celebration. To commemorate their 20th anniversary, BIGBANG is preparing for a new global tour and plans to write a new chapter in K-pop history based on their strong familial bond with YG Entertainment.Ahead of their "return of the king," BIGBANG stated, "We have prepared for this Coachella with a special resolve, as it symbolizes another beginning for us. We plan to deliver the best performance that connects closely with fans worldwide and unites everyone through music, so we hope you will enjoy it together." /elnino8919@osen.co.kr· This article has been translated by Upstage Solar AI.원문보기 (View Original Korean Article)
